flags.question: Identify the top 5 questions with the highest number of favorites that have been asked in 2020.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:ASKED]->(u:User)
WHERE q.createdAt >= datetime('2020-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND q.createdAt < datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z')
RETURN q.title AS title, q.favorites AS favorites, q.link AS link, q.createdAt AS createdAt
ORDER BY q.favorites DESC
LIMIT 5
details: Cypher has (Question)-[:ASKED]->(User) but schema says User->Question

flags.question: What are the 3 most recent questions asked by the user with the highest reputation?
flags.cypher:
// Step 1: Find the user with the highest reputation
MATCH (u:User)
WITH u
ORDER BY u.reputation DESC
LIMIT 1

// Step 2: Find the questions asked by this user
MATCH (u)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH q
ORDER BY q.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 3

// Step 3: Return the details of the 3 most recent questions
RETURN q.title AS title, q.text AS text, q.link AS link, q.createdAt AS createdAt
details: TypeQL uses try{}/custom function but Cypher has no OPTIONAL MATCH

flags.question: Which 3 users have asked questions that are all unanswered but highly upVoted?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.answered = false AND q.upVotes > 0
WITH u, COUNT(q) AS totalQuestions, COLLECT(q) AS questions
WHERE totalQuestions = SIZE([q IN questions WHERE q.answered = false])
RETURN u.display_name, u.link, u.reputation
ORDER BY SIZE([q IN questions WHERE q.upVotes > 0]) DESC
LIMIT 3
details: TypeQL uses not{} but Cypher has no negation

flags.question: What are the first 3 questions asked by the user with the highest reputation?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH u, q
ORDER BY u.reputation DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH u, q
ORDER BY q.createdAt ASC
LIMIT 3
RETURN q.title, q.link, q.createdAt

flags.question: Which 3 users' questions have the most variations in favorites count?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH u, collect(q.favorites) AS favoritesList
WITH u, favoritesList, apoc.coll.max(favoritesList) - apoc.coll.min(favoritesList) AS favoritesVariation
ORDER BY favoritesVariation DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN u.display_name AS user, favoritesVariation

flags.question: List 3 users who have never been downvoted on their questions.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.downVotes = 0
WITH u, COUNT(q) AS questionCount
MATCH (u)-[:ASKED]->(q2:Question)
WITH u, questionCount, COUNT(q2) AS totalQuestions
WHERE questionCount = totalQuestions
RETURN u.display_name AS userName, u.id AS userId, u.link AS userLink
LIMIT 3
details: TypeQL uses not{} but Cypher has no negation

flags.question: Which 3 users have the highest rate of answered questions?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.answered = true
WITH u, COUNT(q) AS answeredQuestions
MATCH (u)-[:ASKED]->(allQuestions:Question)
WITH u, answeredQuestions, COUNT(allQuestions) AS totalQuestions
WITH u, answeredQuestions, totalQuestions, (toFloat(answeredQuestions) / totalQuestions) AS answerRate
ORDER BY answerRate DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN u.display_name AS user, answerRate
details: TypeQL uses try{}/custom function but Cypher has no OPTIONAL MATCH
